title: Huntington Beach — San Pedro Bay Pipeline
short_location: San Pedro Bay, Orange County, California

gallery.blurb: 588 barrels of crude reached the Orange County coast. Which ship released it?

notes: Infrastructure + exoneration case. The San Pedro Bay Pipeline (operator Amplify Energy / Beta Offshore) began leaking the evening of 1 Oct 2021, ~4.5 nm off Huntington Beach; first leak alarm 1 Oct 16:10 PDT (23:10Z), final shutdown 2 Oct 06:04 PDT. This S1A pass is ~2.8 h after the first alarm, oil still leaking. NTSB MIR-24-01 attributes the cause to the containerships MSC DANIT and Beijing dragging anchor and striking the pipeline on 25 Jan 2021 — 8 months before the release. Expect the origin on the pipeline right-of-way and every transiting vessel excluded. acts: add trace/attribute/verify as stages land.
